headline: Before Wikipedia there was Encarta, on a CD-ROM.
slides: Microsoft launched Encarta, a multimedia encyclopedia on disc.
Videos, sound clips, maps, timelines and a quiz game called MindMaze.
Wikipedia launched. Free, and anyone could edit it.
Wikipedia had about 97% of online encyclopedia traffic. Encarta had about 1%.
Encarta had about 62,000 articles. English Wikipedia had over 2.8 million.
